shapes.line: One table of 36 clubs, eight matches per club, and playoffs for ninth to 24th. The draw and results are simulated. Saved group seasons finish in groups, and Manager Hot Seat keeps its own format.
Eight groups of four into the round of 16, two legged ties, away goals count double. That is the real 2020-21 format.
